title: InSaver: Video Downloader
summary: Save Instagram & Tiktok Reels, Stories, videos, photos & profile in HD. No Login
description:
InSaver is a video downloader, Story Saver, media library and creator toolkit for saving, organizing, editing and sharing supported public content.

Download supported public Reels, Stories, Posts, Highlights, photos, videos, carousels and profile photos with permission. Keep content organized, watch it offline, edit it, create captions and hashtags, or repost when you’re ready.

No login or social-media password.

SAVE REELS, STORIES & VIDEOS:

• Download supported public Reels, Stories, Posts and Highlights
• Download supported photos, videos and carousel posts
• Save short-form videos in high quality
• Save public profile photos
• Preview before saving
• Share with other apps

HD VIDEO DOWNLOADER & OFFLINE LIBRARY:

• Download supported content in high quality
• 720p available with the free experience
• Original quality is available with Pro
• Keep saved videos, photos and audio in one library
• Watch saved videos offline
• Search, filter and organize your media

STORIES, HIGHLIGHTS & PROFILES:

• Browse supported public profiles
• View supported public Stories and Highlights
• Preview content before saving
• Save public profile photos in high resolution
• Find content using a username or public link

REPOST & SHARE:

• Repost supported Reels, Stories and Posts
• Share saved photos and videos
• Add creator credit when sharing
• Set reminders for later
• Share directly to other apps

CREATOR TOOLS:

• Generate captions from topics or keywords
• Rewrite captions for different styles
• Find relevant hashtags
• Save and reuse captions
• Edit photos & videos
• Trim, filter and add overlays
• Compress videos
• Split photos into carousel grids
• Convert videos to GIFs
• Mute videos
• Extract audio where supported

CONTENT LIBRARY:

• Create folders and collections
• Search your media library
• Organize Reels, Posts, photos and audio
• Group content by date
• Choose media from Gallery or Collections before editing

INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK CONTENT:

InSaver supports compatible public content from Instagram and TikTok, including supported Reels, Stories, Posts, Highlights, photos, carousels and videos.

Use a supported public link or compatible sharing flow to access available content.

PRIVATE & EASY TO USE:
No social-media password is required. Keep saved content organized in your local library, ready to watch, edit or share.

FAQ:
Q: Can I download Reels and Stories?
A: Yes. InSaver can download compatible public content with permission.

Q: Do I need to log in?
A: No. InSaver does not require your social-media password.

Q: Can I download videos in HD?
A: Yes. Compatible content can be saved in high quality. 720p is available with the free experience; Original quality is available with Pro.

Q: Can I download TikTok videos?
A: Yes. InSaver supports compatible public TikTok videos through supported links and sharing flows. Use only content you have permission to use.

Q: Can I repost saved content?
A: Yes. You can share or repost supported content and add creator credit when appropriate.

Q: Can I create captions and hashtags?
A: Yes. Generate captions, rewrite them, find relevant hashtags and save captions for later.

Q: Can I edit downloaded videos and photos?
A: Yes. Supported tools include trimming, filters, overlays, compression, muting, GIF creation and carousel grids.

INSAVER PRO:
Original Quality · Ad-Free · Premium Tools

Optional subscriptions may be available. Pricing and renewal terms are shown in Google Play before purchase.

DISCLAIMER:
InSaver is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or officially connected with Instagram, TikTok, Meta or ByteDance.

Only download, save, share or repost content that you have permission to use. Public availability does not necessarily mean content may be copied or redistributed. Rights remain with the respective owners.
